name: cfbd-data
description: Lets Claude pull CollegeFootballData.com stats with your own API key, stored securely by Claude Desktop.
long_description: Pairs with the CFBD Analyst skill. Your CollegeFootballData.com API key is entered once here and kept in your operating system's secure storage; Claude never sees it. Requests run from your computer and results are saved in your CFBD data folder so later chats reuse them instead of spending API calls.

tools.name: cfbd_get
tools.description: Fetch CFBD data with your stored key and save it to your data folder

tools.name: cfbd_read
tools.description: Read records from saved CFBD data

tools.name: cfbd_status
tools.description: Check the key works, list saved data and this month's API usage

tools.name: cfbd_team
tools.description: Save, show or clear your favorite team for dashboard colors

api_key.title: CFBD API key
api_key.description: Your free key from https://collegefootballdata.com/key. Stored in your system's secure storage; Claude never sees it.

data_dir.title: CFBD data folder
data_dir.description: Where downloaded data is saved (default: Documents/CFBD). Connect this same folder to your Claude chats.
